description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. The place is 0.002 degrees from the cell's centre: a direct walk of 3.6972364 minutes. Through station 0 it is 2 + 0 + 1.8486182 = 3.8486182, so the walk wins.
